Recreation of the [[Premiere Limited]] Decipher scan [[File:Premiere-D-stormtrooper.gif]] for [[Stormtrooper (Premiere Two-Player) (Unlimited)|Stormtrooper (Unlimited)]]. Outer printed-black border painted white with rounded corners; light gray matte (#c8c8c8) around the card so the white round reads on a white page. Interior pixels unchanged.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/66/Premiere-U-D-stormtrooper.jpg Internet Archive item].
